topic: Scoped Enum Class (enum class) in C++
explanation: In modern C++, 'enum class' introduces scoped enumerations that provide better type safety and namespace control compared to traditional enums. Unlike unscoped enums, enum class members do not implicitly convert to integers, preventing accidental misuse. They are strongly typed and scoped within their enumeration name, which helps avoid name collisions and enhances code clarity, especially in large codebases or libraries.
